title: Understanding Batch Gradient Descent
text: Batch gradient descent uses the entire dataset to compute the gradient at each step. This means it always moves in the direction of the true gradient, not an approximation.

title: Characteristics of Batch Gradient Descent
text: Since batch gradient descent uses the entire dataset, it tends to be more stable and accurate in finding the minimum compared to other types of gradient descent.

title: Evaluating the Description
text: Does the description 'the gradient is approximated and may not descend towards the true minimum' apply to batch gradient descent?
